💧 Ethics & Safety

AI watermark

In simple words

A hidden or visible mark added to AI-made pictures, audio, video or text to show that AI created them.

A mark added to content made by AI, so that people or programs can tell where it came from. Some watermarks are visible, like a small label; others are hidden in the pixels or sounds and can only be found by a special program. They help, but they aren't perfect: some can be removed or damaged by editing the file.

Example. By 2025, some image generators added an invisible watermark to every picture they made, and some apps showed a label such as “AI-generated” on posts.

Related words

  • DeepfakeA fake video, image or voice recording made with AI that shows someone saying or doing something they never did.
  • Diffusion modelAn image generator that learns to remove noise step by step, turning random speckles into a picture that matches a prompt.
  • EU AI ActThe European Union's law on artificial intelligence, adopted in 2024 and often called the world's first broad AI law.
